_comment: One knowledge base data source per Confluence space and per SharePoint folder: a user's grants are a list of these, and every search is filtered to them. A knowledge base holds at most 5 data sources (a fixed quota), so each source names its knowledge base; the app searches every poc3-kb* knowledge base the user has a grant in. A $NAME value is read from infra/local.env.
